proof_scope: In progress. R1770 proves that all polynomial moments x^n*f of a unit-supported L2 input are L1 and L2 with L2 norm at most ||f||. Its classical Fourier transform is smooth, every nth derivative is in L2, and the derivative energy is at most (2*pi)^(2n)*||f||^2. For every compactly supported Schwartz cutoff chi, chi*Ff is embedded in Schwartz space and its inverse Fourier transform is an actual Schwartz band. The band's L2 Fourier representative is exactly chi times the original L2 Fourier representative; exact energy, norm bounds and frequency-zero statements are proved. A pointwise weighted square-sum bound on cutoff values controls total band energy. First and second derivatives of the actual band spectrum satisfy explicit finite-family energy bounds in terms of square-sum constants B0,B1,B2 for cutoff values and derivatives. The constants do not depend on the number of bands. Concrete dyadic cutoffs, spatial-moment conversion, transported derivative square sums and band isolation remain.
